definition:
v
 1) to be or become far, be or become distant, be removed, go far away
    1a) (Qal) to be far, be distant
    1b) (Piel) to send far away, extend
    1c) (Hiphil)
        1c1) to make or exhibit distance, be gone far
        1c2) to remove, put far away
 2) (Niphal) loose

 v inf (as adv)
 3) at a distance
